mentions.name: AutoDBA
mentions.description: This IDE extension (AutoDBA PostgreSQL Insights for VS Code) helps developers and DBAs find and fix common database performance issues, misconfigurations, unused indices, and silent slowdowns directly in the IDE.
mentions.problem: Common database performance issues, misconfigurations, unused indices, and silent slowdowns are hard to find and fix.
